# مؤسسة مظلات وسواتر الريان في جدة | Al-Rayyan Shades & Sandwich Panels

> Certified contractor in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia (established 2014) specializing in polyurethane-insulated Sandwich Panel rooms and warehouses, PVDF/polyethylene car parking shades, modern garden pergolas, laser-cut & Lexan privacy screens (Sawater), and VIP Royal Tents (Byoot Shaar). Open 24/7 across all Jeddah districts including North & South Obhur and Al-Hamdaniya.

## Core Service Pages

- [Home — Al-Rayyan Shades & Sandwich Panels Jeddah](https://alrayyan-panels.com/): Complete overview of 22 specialized architectural shading, thermal insulation, and steel fabrication services in Jeddah.
- [Sandwich Panels Jeddah (تركيب سندويش بنل جدة)](https://alrayyan-panels.com/sandwich-panel-jeddah/): Insulated villa rooftop annexes, rooms, and commercial warehouses (5cm, 7.5cm, 10cm PUR/PIR panels, 40 kg/m³ density, 10-year warranty).
- [Car Shades Jeddah (مظلات سيارات جدة)](https://alrayyan-panels.com/car-shades-jeddah/): Cantilever (كابولي), conical PVDF, Korean PVC, and HDPE car parking shades for villas, palaces, and commercial lots.
- [Garden & Rooftop Pergolas Jeddah (برجولات حدائق وجلسات جدة)](https://alrayyan-panels.com/pergolas-jeddah/): Modern iron-and-Lexan pergolas, wood-cladding WPC outdoor lounges, and hidden LED lighting setups.
- [Privacy Screens Jeddah (سواتر جدة)](https://alrayyan-panels.com/sawater-jeddah/): Laser-cut CNC steel, louvered steel slats, frosted Lexan, and woven privacy screens for villa perimeters.
- [VIP Royal Tents & Qarmid Jeddah (بيوت شعر ملكية وقرميد جدة)](https://alrayyan-panels.com/byoot-shaar-jeddah/): 5-layer insulated royal box tents, traditional Sadu majlis interiors, and Italian/Spanish Qarmid tile roofing.
